card.name: Linking word before the named allergen or drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right before a drug or substance name. Most often 'to' after 'hypersensitivity' in contraindication statements, and the colon after 'Herbal product'.

modes.description: A colon after a category label like 'Herbal product', just before the named substance.

modes.label: Dose label gap
modes.description: The space after 'Maintenance dose :' just before the dose amount.
